# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary and language reference, offering comprehensive definitions, word origins, and linguistic resources for English learners and language enthusiasts.

Merriam-Webster is the leading American English dictionary publisher, featuring over 300,000 word definitions in its free online dictionary and 700,000+ entries in the premium Unabridged edition. The site includes specialized references like the Medical Dictionary, Collegiate Thesaurus, biographical entries, and educational resources for vocabulary building.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and word meanings
- Unabridged Dictionary (700K+ entries)
- Collegiate Dictionary and Thesaurus
- Medical Dictionary
- Webster's Third New International Dictionary
- Vocabulary Builder and SAT/ACT prep
- Etymology and word origins
- Alphabetical word browsing
- Biographical dictionary
- American English usage
- Word games (Quordle)
- Language reference tools
- Greek and Latin roots

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com): Main homepage with 300K+ word definitions and word games like Quordle
- [The Unabridged Dictionary by Merriam-Webster](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/): Premium unabridged dictionary with 700K+ definitions and comprehensive features
- [About the Unabridged](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/info/about-the-unabridged.html): Overview of Merriam-Webster Unabridged features and American English coverage
- [About Us](https://www.merriam-webster.com/about-us): Company history and information about Merriam-Webster dictionary publisher
